WITH campaign AS (
    SELECT campaign_id, start_date, end_date
    FROM dim_campaign
    WHERE campaign_id = 19
),
contacted_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE e.campaign_id = campaign.campaign_id
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_spending
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign.start_date AND campaign.end_date
      AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted_members)
    GROUP BY m.member_id
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacted_members) AS members_contacted,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(total_spending), 0), 2) AS total_spending_eur
FROM member_sales;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members_exposed
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
WHERE e.campaign_id = 19;

WITH targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
holdout AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT member_id
    FROM campaign_holdout
    WHERE campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted) AS targeted_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM holdout) AS holdout_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM targeted t JOIN holdout h ON t.member_id = h.member_id) AS overlap_count;

WITH campaign_dates AS (
    SELECT start_date, end_date FROM dim_campaign WHERE campaign_id = 19
),
contacted_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    CROSS JOIN campaign_dates
    WHERE f.channel_code = 'ST'
      AND s.store_id <> 999
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND f.sale_date BETWEEN campaign_dates.start_date AND campaign_dates.end_date
      AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted_members)
),
web_sales AS (
    SELECT f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    CROSS JOIN campaign_dates
    WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) BETWEEN campaign_dates.start_date AND campaign_dates.end_date
      AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted_members)
)
SELECT 
    'Store' AS channel,
    ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS spending
FROM store_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Web' AS channel,
    ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS spending
FROM web_sales
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    'Total' AS channel,
    ROUND((SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM store_sales) + (SELECT SUM(net_amount) FROM web_sales), 2) AS spending;

WITH contacted_members AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
all_member_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS sale_date,
        f.net_amount,
        f.channel_code
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT web_order_id,
               CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
        FROM fact_web_order
        WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
    ) w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND f.sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24'
      AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted_members)
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    SUM(net_amount) AS total_amount
FROM all_member_sales
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24';

-- Spring Garden Launch 2026: Members contacted and their spending May 4-24, 2026
WITH contacted_members AS (
    -- Distinct members in the campaign exposure table
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
    -- Web order dispatch dates in Helsinki time
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
member_sales AS (
    -- Net sales from contacted members, May 4-24, 2026
    SELECT 
        m.member_id,
        COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS sale_date,
        f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999
      AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted_members)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacted_members) AS members_contacted,
    ROUND(SUM(net_amount), 2) AS total_spending_eur
FROM member_sales
WHERE sale_date BETWEEN '2026-05-04' AND '2026-05-24';
